g.text: UML sequence - durable event to one economic alert, owned data defect and safe message
each projected fact once per current rule;
skip if an overlapping alert exists
undelivered / backlog / aged break / failed message
one OPEN alert per (check, subject) + DATA case + next action
insert read-model rows only (no balance write)
derive (dedupe key per economic / document identity)
deliver: synthetic capture; channel down -> backoff, 6 attempts
